Class MoveChecker

java.lang.Object
model.phaseHandlers.MoveChecker
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardVisitor
public class MoveChecker extends Object implements CardVisitor
Evaluates the legality of potential card draws for a specific player, determining if any valid or forced moves remain available on the board.

This class implements the Visitor pattern to apply type-specific validation rules dynamically. It evaluates cards based on the player's current OfferTileAction and their available resources (e.g., food).

The validation follows these core rules:
  • Character Cards: Valid if permitted by the current tile action.
  • Building Cards: Valid only if the player possesses sufficient food to cover the card's cost and is permitred by the tile action.
  • Event Cards: Strictly invalid, as they cannot be drawn by players.

For performance optimization, the checking mechanisms (checkLegalMoves and checkForcedMoves) utilize short-circuit evaluation, halting iteration as soon as the first legal move is identified.

      public boolean checkForcedMoves(List<TribeCard> allTribeCardsOnBoard)
      Scans the provided list of Tribe Cards (Characters and Events) to determine if at least one mandatory or permissible move exists.

      Performance Note: Utilizes short-circuit evaluation. The iteration halts immediately upon identifying the first valid card.

      Parameters:
      allTribeCardsOnBoard - a list of all currently visible tribe cards on board.
      Returns:
      true if at least one valid draw is found, false otherwise.
